paragraphs.text: A cash-secured put is a short put in which the writer sets aside enough cash to buy the shares at the strike if the put is assigned; the word secured refers to the cash, which the broker holds as collateral for the whole life of the trade [S1]. Assignment is the process by which an option writer is selected to fulfil the obligation of a contract that a holder has exercised, and the OCC assigns exercise notices at random to clearing members with short positions in the same series [S2]. The allocation tilt leans on the VIX, the Cboe Volatility Index, which measures the market's expectation of 30-day volatility in the S&P 500 and is computed from option prices rather than from past returns [S5].

This run split the {{profile.account_value|money}} account evenly: {{allocation.csp_pct|pct}} to cash-secured puts and {{allocation.cash_pct|pct}} held in cash, a tilt of {{allocation.tilt}} with {{allocation.csp_dollars|money}} set aside for puts. The regime was labelled {{regime.label}}, with a VIX of {{regime.vix}} at the {{regime.vix_percentile}}th percentile and the risk-free rate at {{regime.risk_free_rate_pct|pct}}.

The good-to-own quality gate enforces the product promise of "stocks you would be happy to own if assigned" [S3]. It is a filter, not a discovery engine: it decides which tickers are allowed into the option screeners at all, records a reason for every rejection, and produces a score for the survivors [S3].

{{quality_screen.passed_count}} underlyings passed the quality gate: {{quality_screen.passed_tickers|list}}. Notable reasons as given include SPY, which "Owns the whole S&P 500; the most liquid option chain in the market.", and NKE, a "Leading athletic brand with 20+ years of dividend increases." {{quality_screen.excluded_count}} were excluded and the screened universe held {{counts.underlyings_screened}} tickers.

The consumer-trend board watches public conversation on Reddit, X, Wikipedia pageviews, Google Trends and news feeds for rising discussion of products and brands, and resolves that discussion to tickers [S4]. It would be natural to assume a stock with a surging score is a good candidate for selling puts, but for the structure of a short put the opposite is closer to the truth [S4]. The trend board is therefore a secondary signal only.

The trend board's top entries were {{trends[0].ticker}} at a score of {{trends[0].score}} and {{trends[1].ticker}} at {{trends[1].score}}, but these trending tickers are not on the good-to-own list; the universe step skipped them, as the errors record for {{errors|count}} tickers.

Next to every short put the app shows a probability OTM, the model's estimate of the chance that the option finishes out of the money at expiration and therefore expires worthless, which for a cash-secured put writer is the outcome in which the whole premium is kept and no shares are bought [S6].

The bottleneck board is a secondary signal: it re-orders quality-gated stocks, never adds one. Its top-scoring layer, {{bottlenecks.layers[0].name}}, scored {{bottlenecks.layers[0].score}} with a thesis state of {{bottlenecks.layers[0].thesis_state}}; the networking layer scored {{bottlenecks.layers[5].score}} with a state of {{bottlenecks.layers[5].thesis_state}}. Among the companies, {{bottlenecks.companies[4].ticker}} carried the flags {{bottlenecks.companies[4].flags|list}}; the sized position CSP-NKE-2026-11-20-35P had no bottleneck flags, and its realistic loss is {{positions[0].realistic_loss|money}}.

One position was sized: CSP-NKE-2026-11-20-35P, {{positions[0].contracts}} contracts on NKE with a breakeven of {{positions[0].payoff.breakeven|money}} at expiry and a maximum loss of {{positions[0].payoff.max_loss|money}}; its realistic loss is {{positions[0].realistic_loss|money}} and its premium collected was {{positions[0].premium|money}}.

The sizing step left candidates behind: CSP-SPY-2026-11-30-735P was skipped for allocation budget, with a realistic loss of one contract of {{skipped_candidates[0].realistic_loss_per_contract|money}}. The sizer flags read {{risk.sizing_flags|list}}; {{risk.warnings[0]}} {{risk.warnings[1]}} {{risk.warnings[2]}}
